This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Prime Meat and Seafood Fries are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Prime Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Thigh]] with any [[Seafood]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They can be eaten to restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These Meals are considered comfort [[Food]]s, containing choice cuts of both [[Meat]] and Seafood. Based on both the type of seafood used and whether any additional [[Ingredient]]s are added, Link can make several variations of Prime Meat and Seafood Fry: * '''Chilly Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Eating these fries will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electric Ingredients. Link can eat these fries to gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely replenished and overfilled by eating these. * '''Energizing Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing Ingredients. Eating these fries will refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using hasty Ingredients. By eating them, Link's movement speed will be increased. * '''Hearty Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]]s, [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other mighty Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's attack power. * '''Sneaky Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, or other sneaky Ingredients. If eaten, Link will have his [[Stealth]] increased. * '''Spicy Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Prime Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This comfort dish is made with choice cuts of meat and seafood.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other tough Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain a boost to his [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry * Meal * Meat and Seafood Fry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
